title: Exercise Engram MCP composition through production runtime entry points
outcome: Four MCP composition helpers were changed from cfg(test) to allow(dead_code), and ACP retains a runtime_token None branch used only by a test wrapper. This compiles production-unreachable duplicate composition paths and lets tests pass while the real token-bound _for_runtime path regresses. Restore test-only visibility or remove legacy helpers, then drive descriptor tests through the same runtime-token-aware entry points used in production.
acceptance: Release builds contain no duplicate dead MCP composition helpers solely for tests; tests exercise runtime-token-aware production composition for Claude, Codex, and ACP; no allow(dead_code) is needed for these seams; required Rust gates pass.
